diagnosis: The Cloudflare Worker routes whiteboard element modifications directly into the target Durable Object instance using idFromName(boardId). The Worker performs no validation against user identity or workspace membership, permitting any user to inject or modify canvas elements on arbitrary whiteboards across the organization.
